item.ticket: My invoice shows two charges for November.
item.reference_answer: I'm sorry about the duplicate charge. I've asked billing to refund the extra payment; you'll see it within 5 business days.

item.ticket: How do I reset my password?
item.reference_answer: You can reset your password from the sign-in page with the 'Forgot password' link. We'll email you a reset link.

item.ticket: The export button does nothing in Safari.
item.reference_answer: Thanks for reporting this. We've reproduced the Safari export issue and a fix is scheduled for next week's release.

item.ticket: Can I change my plan mid-cycle?
item.reference_answer: Yes. You can change plans at any time in Billing settings, and we'll prorate the difference.
SSO via SAML is available on the Business plan. I can connect you with our team to set it up.
I'm sorry you lost your draft. Drafts are kept for 30 days in Trash under Settings; I can restore it for you if you share the title.
